 Rainy's Story

Rainy is a 5 1/2 month old short hair tabby mix. He was found on a rainy day and quickly taken to the vet to get checked out, where he was given his vaccinations and brought back to good health. He has since enjoyed his time with his foster siblings, playing with them and being a good-natured cat.

Rainy was a bit shy at first, though quickly warmed up to both people and other cats. He loves to eat and play, especially with the other cats he's fostered with. He is neutered, vaccinated, litter box trained and has shown no aggression. Overall, Rainy would be a good fit for most any home.

Rainy is currently being fostered in Houston but can be transported to any state and even Canada to the right home.

Rainy's adoption fee is $400 USD and his transport is $100.

Saylor Story:
 Saylor - Loving Siamese Girl's Story

Saylor is a one-year-old female lynx point Siamese. She is calm and very affectionate - she likes a lot of petting and attention! If you're looking for a cat that wants lots of love and needs lots of snuggles, she's your girl!

Unlike other Siamese, Saylor's voice can barely be heard. She tries to meow, but only a little noise comes out. It's really cute!

Saylor seems good with other cats and is fine with the two older dogs in her foster home. She has been spayed and vaccinated, and has had her hernia repaired.

One thing: Saylor loves her canned food- she would be unhappy to just be fed kibble, so her future adopter would have to be prepared to buy her canned food along with kibble. Everyone is allowed to be a little bit of a diva, right?!

If you are looking for two kitties, consider pairing Saylor and Rip! They have been fostered together and are bonded. Saylor plays with Rip and tries to clean him when he will slow down enough to let her. They can be adopted separately, though.
